scope: Design-mode primary-source audit for the remaining selector-style referent candidate; no native execution or efficacy claim

candidate.hypothesis: Selecting object candidates from aligned positional and semantic text-point features will raise the selected referent query above same-class distractors.
candidate.proposed_surface: Replace or alter candidate selection using text-conditioned positional and semantic alignment.

primary_source.title: Unified Representation Space for 3D Visual Grounding
findings: Section III-C defines language-guided query selection (LGQS) using positional and semantic information from both modalities to identify object candidate points aligned with the text.
The module outputs Nq indices and initializes object candidate points from the selected indices.
The method reports at least 2.24% improvement on ScanRefer and Nr3D/Sr3D over its baseline.
The paper states that LGQS is inspired by Grounding DINO, so the candidate also inherits an established 2D vision-language query-selection mechanism.

project_gate.violated_constraint: The goal explicitly says not to make changes to pooling, selector, write-back location, or variant count the research main line.
project_gate.novelty_result: Prior art on ScanRefer plus established Grounding DINO-style query selection.
project_gate.causal_result: The candidate changes selector inputs and candidate initialization, not a new causal supervision unit for the confirmed referent-selection failure.

resource_consequence.assessment: Would require a new aligned text-point representation and candidate-selection path; no efficiency evidence exists for this project.
resource_consequence.note: Rejected before resource implementation because it fails the explicit selector constraint and novelty gate.

decision.outcome: Do not admit, implement, enqueue, or rename language-guided query selection.
decision.rejected_remainder: Candidate budget 1 remains unfilled; an empty slot is preferable to a banned and already-published selector variant.
decision.next_action: Continue only with a genuinely new structural information path or causal supervision unit outside selector, quality-target, ranking, consistency, matching, and counterfactual families.

limitations: This is a primary-source and goal-constraint audit, not a reproduction of UniSpace-3D.
No claim is made that LGQS is ineffective; it is rejected for this project because it is prior art and violates the current selector constraint.
No code, model, config, admission receipt, queue entry, sync, or training run was created.
